title: Your First Weekend at College of Charleston, Shared as Cards
description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Step Through the Arch
cards.subtitle: The Official Welcome Tradition
cards.notes: Walk through the archway inscribed with 'Know Thyself' to enter the Cistern Yard. This symbolic entry marks your official start as a member of the College community.
cards.short_summary: A historic archway serving as the ceremonial entrance for new students during Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: New students pass through the arch at Porter's Lodge on their first day to enter the Cistern Yard and officially sign 'the book'.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; ceremonial walks occur during Fall Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Attend New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Gather Under the Oaks
cards.notes: Join your classmates for the annual gathering in this iconic green space. It is the primary site for welcoming the new class and introducing academic traditions.
cards.short_summary: The historic heart of campus featuring live oaks and Randolph Hall, used for major ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Convocation is an annual gathering in the Cistern Yard where students embark on their intellectual journeys at the College.
cards.source_title: Fall Welcome Weekend Celebrates New College of Charleston Students
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space accessible 24/7; events scheduled during orientation weekend.

cards.title: Join the Party on the Green
cards.subtitle: Pre-Convocation Social
cards.notes: Meet fellow new students for a social gathering behind the library before the Cougar Walk begins. It's a prime spot for making your first campus connections.
cards.short_summary: A large grassy area behind Addlestone Library used for student events and outdoor studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The Party on the Green is a gathering for 500–600 students before they take the Cougar Walk to the Cistern Yard.
cards.source_title: Fall Welcome Weekend Celebrates New College of Charleston Students

cards.title: Grab a First-Weekend Meal
cards.subtitle: Campus Dining Hub
cards.notes: Refuel between orientation sessions at this central dining location. It offers various food stations and is a common meeting point for freshmen.
cards.short_summary: A major campus dining facility offering diverse meal options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Liberty St. Food Hall is listed as a primary dining location for students on campus.
cards.access_notes: Requires meal plan or payment; hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Relax by the Turtle Pond
cards.subtitle: Quiet Campus Retreat
cards.notes: Take a break in the garden outside the student center. Look for the resident turtles in the fountain while you decompress from move-in stress.
cards.short_summary: A peaceful garden area with picnic tables and a fountain located at the student center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Stern Center Garden features picnic tables and a fountain with turtles, serving as a quiet study or break spot.
cards.source_title: Best Studies Spots On Campus At College Of Charleston
cards.access_notes: Open daily; located adjacent to the food court.

cards.title: Find Your Classrooms
cards.subtitle: Student-Led Campus Tours
cards.notes: Meet at the mall for a personalized tour to locate your Monday morning classes. Current students lead these sessions to help you navigate the historic campus.
cards.short_summary: A central campus walkway and gathering space between major academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: Classroom tours with orientation interns meet at Cougar Mall to help students find their classes.
cards.source_title: Weeks of Welcome - College of Charleston
cards.access_notes: Tours typically run 11am-1pm during opening weekend.

cards.title: Explore the Historic Market
cards.subtitle: Downtown Discovery
cards.notes: Walk a few blocks off campus to browse local crafts and souvenirs. It's a classic Charleston experience for students getting to know their new city.
cards.short_summary: A historic market complex featuring local vendors, sweetgrass baskets, and regional food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Charleston City Market is a hub of activity and commerce accessible by foot from the College.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 9:30am; Night Market hours vary.

cards.title: Walk to the Pineapple Fountain
cards.subtitle: Scenic Peninsula Views
cards.notes: Take a sunset stroll to the harbor to see the famous Pineapple Fountain. It's a popular spot for students to relax and enjoy the ocean breeze.
cards.short_summary: A scenic park along the Cooper River known for its fountains and harbor views.
cards.evidence_claim: Waterfront Park is a popular attraction for students to hang out after classes with plenty of benches and grass.
cards.source_title: The Best Study Spots for CofC Students
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily; approximately 15-minute walk from campus.

cards.title: Scope Out a Study Nook
cards.subtitle: Late Night Prep
cards.notes: Visit the library to find your favorite study spot before the first week of classes. The higher floors offer quieter zones for focused work.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library featuring extensive study spaces and a Starbucks.
cards.evidence_claim: Addlestone Library offers extended hours and requires Cougar Cards for access after midnight.
cards.access_notes: Cougar Card required for entry after midnight; public access during day hours.

cards.title: Visit the Cougar Den
cards.subtitle: Athletic Spirit Hub
cards.notes: Check out the home of Cougar basketball. Familiarize yourself with the student section entry so you're ready for the first home game of the season.
cards.short_summary: The primary indoor sports arena for the College of Charleston athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: TD Arena has a 1,000 seat student section; entry requires a valid College of Charleston student ID.
cards.access_notes: Student section is general admission; tickets must be claimed via student portal for games.
